effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.) and -3000 DP until their turn ends.
[Your Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, this Digimon may digivolve into a [TB] trait Digimon card in the hand with the cost reduced by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 [TB] trait Digimon card with 5000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.
